sources.title: WebBrain — Free Open-Source AI Browser Agent
sources.snippet: The Open-Source AI Browser Agent Free, open-source alternative to Claude in Chrome. Use any model, including local ones, so your pages never leave your machine.

sources.title: Nanbeige 4.2 3B BF16 WebBrain planner benchmark - WebBrain Blog
sources.snippet: We tested Nanbeige4.2-3B in BF16 on an RTX 5090. Its official agent benchmarks beat Qwen 3.5 9B and Gemma 4 12B, but WebBrain's frozen browser-planner replay did not reproduce that lead.

sources.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B: Open 33B Agent Model, 80.9 on Terminal-Bench ...
sources.snippet: Nanbeige4.3-33B is a new open-weight dense model released on October 24, 2026 under the Apache 2.0 license, built for coding and office-style agents. The model card on Hugging Face reports that it leads three comparable 30B-class models on most agentic benchmarks, including 80.9 on Terminal-Bench 2.1.

sources.title: GitHub - webbrain-one/webbrain: Open-source AI browser agent for Chrome ...
sources.snippet: WebBrain Open-source AI browser agent for chatting with pages, automating tasks, and running multi-step workflows with your choice of LLM. English · 中文 · Français · Docs · Website · Discord · GPL-3.-or-later WebBrain is a web browser extension that puts an AI agent in a side panel next to your tabs.
